name: Exhaust temperature spread (combustor fault)
description: Unit carries 80 % load. Thermocouple 4 starts to read low at 5 degC/s, as it would behind a failed burner. The spread (max - min of the four) must raise an alarm at 40 degC and trip at 80 degC, with first-out recorded, while the median of four keeps the control temperature sane.

criteria.text: Spread alarm is raised within 15 s
No trip while the spread is below 80 degC
Trip once the spread passes 80 degC (12 to 30 s)
Fuel flow is zero at the end
True gas temperature stays below 620 degC throughout

negative_tests.text: With the spread trip removed the failing burner is never acted on: no trip is raised.
